image_title: Consolidated Financial Data - Third Quarter, Fiscal 2026
summary: This table presents the consolidated financial data for Infosys for the third quarter of Fiscal 2026, focusing on effort and utilization metrics, employee statistics, and cash metrics. Key metrics include onsite and offshore effort percentages, utilization rates including and excluding trainees, total employee counts, and financial figures such as free cash flow (FCF) and consolidated cash and investments. Notable trends include a slight decrease in utilization rates from the previous quarter and a significant increase in total employees compared to the same period last year. The cash metrics indicate a decrease in FCF and consolidated cash and investments over the year, reflecting changes in financial performance.
